outline:

flexible_learning.content: Students will visit my laboratory to gain hands-on experience and a deeper understanding of copper electrodeposition and Cu-Cu direct bonding technologies. During the visit, they will learn about the principles of electrodeposition, electrolyte preparation, process parameter control, and Cu film fabrication. They will also be introduced to Cu-Cu direct bonding techniques, including surface preparation, bonding conditions, and the evaluation of bonding quality.
flexible_learning.outcome: This visit aims to strengthen their practical knowledge of advanced semiconductor packaging and provide insights into the application of these technologies in 3D integrated circuits (3D ICs).
